upstream.project: ERFA — Essential Routines for Fundamental Astronomy (liberfa/erfa)
upstream.derivedFrom: IAU SOFA (ERFA is a re-licensed derivative; this port is ERFA-derived, not SOFA)
upstream.archiveProvenanceNote: Archive obtained in Phase 3B.4.2A; its SHA-256 matches the 3B.4.2A record and is re-verified by every extraction and build script.

epv00.source: src/epv00.c static arrays e0x..s2z and am12..am33

nut00b.source: src/nut00b.c struct table x[] and DPPLAN/DEPLAN

extraction.method: Automated: Node script parses upstream C (comments stripped), copies numeric tokens in order, emits TypeScript, formats with repository prettier, re-parses every emitted literal and requires Object.is equality with the upstream token value.
transformations: C comments stripped; numeric tokens copied verbatim in upstream order
prettier (repository config) normalises literal spelling, e.g. e+00 -> e00; values re-verified with Object.is
C struct rows of nut00b emitted as 11-element numeric arrays (5 integer multipliers + 6 doubles)
erfam.h constants emitted as the shortest round-trip decimal of the same double (upstream text kept in a trailing comment)

handWritten.content: transcription of eraEpv00, eraNut00b, eraPfw06, eraObl06, eraPm, eraPn, eraAb, eraRx, eraRz and the eraApcs velocity step; operation order preserved
composition: light time, aberration, F-W rotation to the true ecliptic/equinox of date
deterministic fdlibm (FreeBSD msun) sin/cos/atan2 ports, Sun Microsystems notice preserved
project code: targets, integer-grid root solver, classification
project code: clock-v1; Espenak–Meeus Delta-T polynomials as in astronomy-engine 2.1.19 (MIT); IERS leap table
project code: serialization and civil classification

runtimeAssumptions.language: ECMAScript 2023 (no BigInt, no WASM, no dynamic code)
runtimeAssumptions.floatingPoint: IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest-even for + - * /; % is exact (ECMAScript remainder = C fmod); Math.sqrt assumed correctly rounded (IEEE-754 required op; verified by cross-runtime parity); Math.floor exact
runtimeAssumptions.transcendental: Math.sin/cos/atan2 are NOT used by the engine; deterministic fdlibm ports instead
runtimeAssumptions.endianness: none: the only bit access uses DataView with explicit big-endian default; no typed-array aliasing
runtimeAssumptions.fma: JavaScript never contracts a*b+c; the upstream C comparison is compiled with -ffp-contract=off to match
runtimeAssumptions.dates: Date.UTC and Date.prototype.toISOString only (spec-defined, timezone independent)

attribution.erfa: Retain NumFOCUS copyright, the three conditions, disclaimer and no-endorsement clause (LICENSE-ERFA.txt); identify the code as ERFA-derived and not SOFA.
attribution.fdlibm: Retain the Sun Microsystems permission notice in detMath.ts.
attribution.astronomyEngine: Delta-T polynomials mirror astronomy-engine 2.1.19 (MIT); its notice is already in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
